about: Lower bounds on the distance of the codes of transversal_t_codes/ from the doubling theorem of Jain and Albert (arXiv:2408.12752, Sec. III): d >= min(d_sd, d_tri + 2) at every doubling, from one qubit up. Where every self-dual input along a code's chain has a distance proved in this folder, self_dual_distance_proved_by names the test that proves the last one, and the record has the file's tool. Where the chain uses a quantum QR code of length 167, 191 or 199, the record has its own tool and rests_on_paper lists the minimum distances of the extended QR codes it takes from the paper's Table II without re-proving them, and proved_here lists what is proved here: the theorem, the code's structure and every other input along the chain. columns_sha256 is the SHA-256 of the code's columns as compact JSON (master_catalog/constructions.digest), the circuit the catalogue stores. witness is a harmful fault of weight lower_bound. Written by transversal_t_codes/certify_distances.py.
tool: the doubling theorem of Jain and Albert (arXiv:2408.12752, Sec. III)
